title: Desmin filaments extend along actin filaments within the mouse skeletal muscle sarcomere
task: Determine 3D spatial organization of desmin intermediate filaments in sarcomeres
key_results: dSTORM and SIM microscopy reveal desmin extends from Z-lines into sarcomere interior aligned with actin filaments; dominant-negative desmin reduces active tension at longer sarcomere lengths
comments: The finding that desmin aligns with actin rather than remaining confined to Z-lines substantially revises the structural model of sarcomeric organization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Desmin intermediate filaments are confined to Z-lines
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; desmin extends into sarcomere interior aligned with actin

hypotheses.hypothesis: Desmin participates in sarcomere mechanics and force production
hypotheses.result: Supported; desmin disruption selectively reduces active tension at longer sarcomere lengths

title: Common misconceptions in life sciences about the concentrations and toxicity of perchlorates on Mars
task: Clarify perchlorate concentrations and toxicity mechanisms relevant to Mars habitability
key_results: Identifies misconceptions in perchlorate exposure levels and toxicity mechanisms; proposes corrections to current understanding
comments: This is a critical review addressing conceptual errors rather than presenting new experimental data, making quantitative validation difficult.

title: Spatial reprogramming of AP-1 complexes by mutant p53 flips the transcriptional output of the FOSL1 enhancer-promoter axis to drive migration
task: Mechanistic basis of mutant p53-driven EMT and cancer migration
key_results: Mutant p53 redirects c-JUN/FRA1 complexes from CREs in FOSL1 intron 1 to TREs in promoter, switching FOSL1 from silenced to activated state; establishes self-reinforcing loop driving pro-migratory progression
comments: Novel spatial reprogramming mechanism elegantly explains p53 GOF; therapeutic vulnerability depends on targeting specific AP-1 complex configurations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mutant p53 flips FOSL1 transcriptional output by spatial redistribution of AP-1 complexes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—wtp53/c-JUN/ATF2 repress at CREs; mutp53/c-JUN/FRA1 activate at TREs

title: Heparan sulfate sulfatases are essential for the patterning of human stem cell-derived midbrain dopaminergic neurons
task: Role of heparan sulfate sulfatases in human midbrain dopaminergic neuron patterning from iPSCs
key_results: SULF1/2 knockout increases 6-O-sulfated heparan sulfate and disrupts anteroposterior and dorsoventral patterning; knockout cells adopt hindbrain/spinal/neural crest fates; FGF inhibition partially rescues midbrain fate but not ventral identity
comments: Identifies extracellular glycosaminoglycan modification as critical overlooked layer in neural patterning; FGF-independent mechanism remains incompletely characterized.

model_io.model: Human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: SULF1/2 are essential for mDA neuron patterning in vitro
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—knockout causes loss of ventral midbrain identity and adoption of alternate fates

hypotheses.hypothesis: SULF1/2 effects are mediated through FGF signaling
hypotheses.result: Partially supported—FGF inhibition restores midbrain but not ventral identity, suggesting additional mechanisms

title: A quantitative deep-learning-based framework reveals a continuum of chromatin sensitivities across transcription factors
task: Quantifying chromatin sensitivity of transcription factors
key_results: Chromatin sensitivity is a continuum across TFs, correlating with motif strength; activation occurs via mixed hierarchical-cooperative mechanisms
comments: Resolves false dichotomy between hierarchical and cooperative binding models with quantitative framework.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TF binding follows purely hierarchical mechanism
hypotheses.result: Rejected; continuum of sensitivities indicates mixed mechanisms

hypotheses.hypothesis: TF binding follows purely cooperative mechanism
hypotheses.result: Rejected; evidence for locus-specific mixture of hierarchical and cooperative binding

title: Late-stage clinical development pathways for Lassa fever vaccines: scientific, operational, and regulatory considerations
task: Clinical development pathways for Lassa fever vaccine licensure
key_results: Identified alternative regulatory pathways beyond Phase 3 efficacy trials to advance vaccine candidates
comments: Addresses practical challenge that endemic low-incidence diseases cannot support traditional RCT designs.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Alternative clinical pathways can enable licensure without traditional Phase 3 efficacy trials
hypotheses.result: Feasible regulatory approaches identified by CEPI with realistic evidence expectations

title: TransAct: efficient attention-based temporal modelling for real-time wearable human activity recognition
task: Efficient temporal modeling for real-time wearable activity recognition
key_results: Transformer (TransAct) achieves 95.10% accuracy on UCI HAR and 86.13% on PAMAP2; 2–3× higher latency than CNN-LSTM
comments: Null ablation findings and dataset-dependent improvements underscore that architectural advantage is not universal and comes with real computational penalty.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer architecture improves HAR accuracy over CNN-LSTM
hypotheses.result: Marginally supported on UCI HAR (p=0.050), clearly supported on PAMAP2 (p=0.012), not supported on OPPORTUNITY overall accuracy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Positional encoding, multi-head attention, and layer normalization individually improve performance
hypotheses.result: Rejected; ablation study shows no statistically detectable individual contribution (p>0.9)

title: Stromal enriched metastatic decider drives lymph node metastasis in lung adenocarcinoma
task: Identify metastasis-associated spatial niches in lung adenocarcinoma lymph node dissemination
key_results: Stromal-enriched metastatic decider (SEED) spots near POSTN+ stroma; CYP24A1 enrichment associated with worse prognosis and lymph node metastasis
comments: Spatial transcriptomics analysis is limited to eight patients; mechanistic link between CYP24A1 and metastatic competence remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transcriptionally similar primary-to-metastasis regions define metastasis-associated spatial niches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SEED spots identified and enriched near POSTN+ stroma at tumor–stroma interfaces

hypotheses.hypothesis: CYP24A1 expression marks metastatic-competent cancer cells
hypotheses.result: Supported; CYP24A1 enrichment in SEED regions and IFNγ-associated subpopulation; worse prognosis association

title: Multimodal digital biomarker for asthma: complementary roles of vocal, clinical and demographic factors
task: Multimodal asthma identification via voice and clinical data
key_results: AUROC 0.83, Brier score 0.18; reading-passage modality weight increased with respiratory symptom burden
comments: Self-reported asthma diagnosis lacks gold-standard spirometry validation, limiting clinical applicability claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal integration outperforms unimodal approaches for asthma detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; multimodal AUROC 0.83 exceeded unimodal performance

title: PATBox for reproducible benchmarking of photoacoustic reconstruction
task: Benchmarking photoacoustic computed tomography reconstruction methods
key_results: Metric-dependent algorithm rankings: delay-and-sum optimal for NRMSE/correlation; SCF delay-and-sum optimal for SSIM/SBR; time reversal optimal for CNR. Detector bandwidth identified as largest source of image degradation.
comments: Comprehensive simulation-based validation framework that explicitly avoids claiming universal optimality, instead clarifying trade-offs across reconstruction families.

model_io.model: k-Wave simulation + multiple reconstruction algorithms (delay-and-sum, sign-coherence-factor delay-and-sum, time reversal)
outputs: quantitative metrics (NRMSE, correlation, SSIM, SBR, CNR)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Method rankings vary significantly across image quality metrics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: different algorithms rank first under different metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Detector bandwidth is primary physical degradation source
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: sequential degradation analysis showed bandwidth produces largest initial fidelity loss

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong background suppression preserves weak vascular branching
hypotheses.result: Refuted: strong suppression does not necessarily preserve branching structure

title: Strain-driven and electric-field-tunable self-morphotropic phase boundary in nitride perovskite
task: Design ultrahigh piezoelectric nitride perovskite via strain-tuned morphotropic phase boundary
key_results: Piezoelectric coefficients exceed conventional nitride piezoelectrics (AlN, AlScN, GaScN) by orders of magnitude; electric-field-tunable self-morphotropic phase boundary in LaWN₃ achieves polarization rotation under biaxial strain
comments: First-principles prediction of strain-driven SMPB in nitrides offers a practical Si-compatible alternative to lead-based perovskites, though experimental validation of claimed ultrahigh responses remains pending.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Biaxial strain induces sequential symmetry transitions enabling polarization rotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via symmetry analysis showing strain-driven SMPB

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electric field dynamically tunes SMPB and enhances piezoelectricity
hypotheses.result: Ultrahigh piezoelectric stress and strain coefficients achieved

title: Microstructural changes in radiochromic film and dosimetry in magnetic field
task: Validate radiochromic film dosimetry accuracy in magnetic resonance-guided radiotherapy
key_results: Crystal structures align within ±80–±100° under 0.35 T magnetic field (vs. random 360° without MF); optical density variations remain within experimental uncertainty (<0.5% difference) across 2–16 Gy doses
comments: Resolves conflicting prior reports by separating topochemical polymerization directionality from total polymerized material, though mechanism of dose-independent OD requires deeper investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnetic field affects crystal microstructure but not total polymerization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; crystal length invariant, angular alignment pronounced (±80–±100°)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microstructural changes compromise dosimetric accuracy in MF
hypotheses.result: Refuted; optical density differences within experimental uncertainty

title: Quantitative evaluation of single-grating phase-contrast imaging with a femtosecond laser–plasma K $$\alpha$$ X-ray source
task: Demonstrate single-grating X-ray phase-contrast imaging with femtosecond laser-plasma Kα source
key_results: Phase retrieval correlation coefficient 0.922 ± 0.008 between theory and experiment; Confidence Map self-consistency metric validates parametric study; two operating regimes (fixed photon count vs. fixed acquisition time) characterized
comments: Novel femtosecond laser-plasma Kα source enables quasi-monochromatic phase contrast with encouraging quantitative fidelity, though time-resolved application requires further optimization of exposure time vs. spatial resolution trade-off.

model_io.model: Single 2D-grating phase retrieval with femtosecond laser-plasma X-ray source
inputs: varying source coherence and photon flux

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-grating phase retrieval achieves high-fidelity phase measurement with laser-plasma Kα source
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; correlation 0.922 ± 0.008 with theory under varying conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: X-ray source coherence and flux optimize exposure time vs. spatial resolution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via parametric study of fixed photon count and fixed acquisition time regimes
